newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends steady to slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends steady to slightly higher.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed steady to slightly higher, with late selling in three nearby contracts erasing moderate gains, traders said.
Much of the late selling appeared to be balancing of accounts ahead of the weekend. Traders said there a lack of fundamental news to encourage retaining positions through the weekend.
News that Egypt was seeking to buy 50,000 tonnes of U.S., Australian or French wheat failed to stem the late slide in futures prices.
MGE spring wheat closed unchanged to up two cents a bushel with December up 1/2 at $4.06-3/4 per bushel. March 1997 ended unchanged at $3.91-1/4, after earlier setting a contract low of $3.90.
Only MGE December barley traded, closing unchanged at $6.70 per cwt.
